Name: Dehydrate Your Vegetables
Author: Suntooth
Description:
[size=3]Very simply, this mod lets you put vegetables in the dehydrator. The final item has the same item ID as dried fruit, so should act the exact same in terms of things like gifting and the Artisan profession.[/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[size=3]Any item with the context tag "category_vegetable" will be dryable. If a mod that adds vegetables has done its context tags well, they should be dryable, but if not then I am unlikely to add compatibility to this mod.[/size]
[size=3]May not be compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45327]Some Vegetable Dehydrator Products[/url] (a much higher-effort mod than this...).[/size]

[size=4][b]Self-promotion[/b][/size]
[size=3]Do you like mods that let you do more with your items? Then you may like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49592]Deconstruct More Things[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12997]Age More Things[/url]![/size]
